title: Do a Physical Examination for the Country's Higher Education

context_sources.name: Winston and Zimmerman, Peer Effects in Higher Education
Saaty, Decision making with the analytic hierarchy process

limitations: Nearly every formula is a private-use glyph. Reconstructed in standard form.
Running headers leak into the text.
The combination rule for the three sets of weights is never stated.
The fitted exponential coefficients and the system dynamics rates are absent.
No data source is named for the 23 indicators.

tasks: Build an index for the health of any nation's higher education and grade countries
Choose a country with room to improve and set a vision against a peer
Test whether the policies reach the vision

section_map.summary: NHHE by combined weights and TOPSIS, NRHHE against income, Italy chosen, vision by 2035, change admitted difficult.
National systems rarely judged. Health decides whether a country flourishes.
Four hypotheses, two of them stated as premises for later sections.
Five headings, 23 indicators, four normalizations, three weighting methods, TOPSIS, four grades.
Exponential curve. Italy falls to last. UK is the peer. Vision at 95 percent.
ANOVA picks five levers. Three stages. System dynamics says the path reaches the vision.
Five groups, each given a benefit and then a cost.
Half a point of GDP does not flip the trend. Two weaknesses conceded.

contributions.summary: Health judged against the score income predicts, so a rich underperformer is visible.
The target is a discount on a real peer, different by component.
Every affected group is given its cost as well as its benefit.

dependency_graph.handoff: The NHHE scores of 40 countries are plotted against income to build the expected curve
The vision scores set the target the policy path is asked to reach by 2035

assumptions.summary: Countries within 0.03 on income are treated as equal, and should then show equal health.
Italy adopts the policy. The UK does not reform for fifteen years.
The system lags the economy, so fast growth can lower the adjusted rank.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Four normalizations. Logistic for unbounded indicators. Cauchy membership anchored at three grades.

models.summary: Combined weighting and TOPSIS, graded by fuzzy clustering.
Exponential curve of score on income, gap read as relative health.
System dynamics on five levers chosen by ANOVA.

verification.summary: Spending moved by 0.5 percent of GDP. Direction of the forecast unchanged, deviation called small.

results_trace.summary: Italy 0.31, rank 26, then rank 40 after the income adjustment.
Holt chosen, R-squared 0.6367 and 0.6393. UK income from 0.81296 to 0.83129.
Vision score 0.41823. Prose says 95, 95, 90, 95, 100 percent of the UK. Achievement cell equals the UK figure (100 not 95). Sustainable cell is 95 percent of the UK (not 100).
Spending from 1.5 to 2 percent of GDP. Score rises and steepens over fifteen years.

writing_logic.summary: Two assumptions are labelled as premises for named later sections.
The income effect is observed in the ranking, then tested indicator by indicator, then fitted.
Each impact group gets a paragraph of gains followed by a paragraph of costs.

language_observations.summary: 'Physical examination' frames the whole task and is dropped immediately. It never becomes a metaphor system.
The logistic function is justified by three required behaviors before it is named.
The case is the country furthest from the curve, and the rank collapse from 26th to 40th is the evidence.
Continuity is defended by implementers' acceptance, not by administrative tidiness.
The closing summary says reality and plan remain apart, and names waste, inefficiency and lack of funds.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: Choosing the country that falls furthest when income is accounted for is a sharper rule than choosing the lowest score.
A target expressed as a percentage of a named peer is auditable. An unnamed aspiration is not.
Pairing every benefit with a cost, including corruption and polarization, keeps the recommendation from reading as a pitch.

weaknesses.summary: The weight combination rule is missing and the judgment matrix is withheld.
The system dynamics model has a diagram and no equations, so the 2035 claim cannot be checked.
Authors: indicator choice is subjective, the classification is vague, and the no-policy forecast skips the historical calculation.

independent_extensions.summary: Recompute the no-policy path from historical indicator data instead of from predicted income.
Publish the rate equations and re-estimate them.

candidate_rule_impacts.summary: A score compared with the value a background variable predicts, so rich and poor are not graded on one line.
Policy staged in equal periods, with feedback allowed to revise the next period.

unresolved_questions.question: How are the AHP, entropy and variation weights combined?
What rate equations generate the path in Figure 15?
